source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Operation in polar waters shall be taken into account, as appropriate, in the Cargo Record Book, the Manual and the shipboard marine pollution emergency plan for noxious liquid substances or the shipboard marine pollution emergency plan as required by MARPOL Annex II.

contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN polar_operation_coverage shall be present in the applicable Cargo Record Book, Manual, and NLS or marine pollution emergency plan.
